title: UPDATE: Microsoft 128GB Surface Laptop Ultra Sells Out on Preorder
summary:
Demand for on-device artificial intelligence has exhausted the pre-order supply of the highest-end Surface Laptop Ultra before its Oct. 16 ship date. The $5,899 model, which features 128GB of unified memory and an Nvidia RTX Spark chip, sold out ahead of the official launch, signaling a shift in consumer appetite for high-RAM hardware. The laptop's entry-level version starts at $2,599 and offers capabilities like 1 petaflop of AI compute to run frontier models without relying on the cloud.

The device serves as the anchor for "Hybrid Intelligence," using a model router to delegate tasks between local hardware and the cloud to cut token costs. Microsoft showcased the laptop running the 284B-parameter DeepSeek V4 Flash model, which requires roughly 60GB of memory when quantized to 1.6 bits. Along with the laptop, Microsoft made its Execution Containers agent sandbox generally available on Windows 11 and introduced a $5,999 RTX Spark Dev Box for enterprise development.

selectedTweets.bestBit: Microsoft Execution Containers (MXC) is now generally available on Windows 11, keeping agents contained within boundaries the operating system enforces.
selectedTweets.text:
Today, we announced new @Windows platform capabilities and @surface devices built to empower people and organizations for the era of hybrid intelligence. Here are some of the highlights:

- It all starts with trust. Microsoft Execution Containers (MXC) is now generally available on Windows 11, keeping agents contained within boundaries the operating system enforces.

- HydraFusion brings hybrid intelligence to life, allowing models to run locally while seamlessly accessing the cloud when more scale or capability is needed. We're working with @github to extend HydraFusion to Windows.

- This fall, Search on the taskbar adds thousands of quick actions, making it easier to adjust settings and get things done as fast as you can type.

- @MSFTCopilot is getting more powerful on Windows. With hybrid intelligence, it can tap into your PC's local capabilities and turn your requests into action, while keeping you in control.

- Local agents are coming to Windows too. Muse is on its way as a native Windows app with MXC integration, and Hermes, OpenClaw, and Perplexity are already building local experiences on Windows.

- Surface Laptop Ultra, built with NVIDIA RTX Spark, is the most powerful Surface we've ever built. It's available for pre-order today, along with the Surface RTX Spark Dev Box and new RTX Spark PCs from our partners. Call of Duty is coming to RTX Spark in 2027.

Read more on the Windows Blog: https://t.co/DRx3HgDqsS
